A '''drag course''' used for [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] existed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer rim]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. More difficult than the other drag courses on the planet, it featured sharp turns and tight squeezes in between rocks and cliff-sides. The entirety of the course took place within the deserts of Tatooine. A [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] would occasionally park near the course, providing an obstacle to [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], albeit a fairly out of the way one. The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] from [[Hok/Legends|Hok]], [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]], was favored on this course, and he would challenge other pilots to race against him here.<ref name="EiR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The course first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Game Boy|Gameboy Color]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''.<ref name="EiR" />
